title: This crazy simple app makes $50K/month
description:
6 months ago, Lino had never built an app in his life. Then he stumbled upon the app community on X, made some connections, and started building. Just 6 months later, he's grown his first app to over $50K per month and changed his life forever. In this video, he will break down his unbelievable app idea and how he grew it so fast. 

*iOS App Ideas Database:* https://clickhubspot.com/a68v

Say hi to Lino: https://x.com/LinoLeighton
Check out AbMaxx: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/abmaxx-become-shredded/id6757769125

🔔 Follow the Second Channel: @StarterStoryBuild
